conventions: Literal ASCII transcription: x is direct product, colon is the printed extension notation, dot is the printed nonspecified extension. Parentheses and order are preserved; no action is inferred from the label. Standard L and U names mean projective special groups. Each asserted explicit target receives an actual bijective group homomorphism. All other extension strings are attributed, not claimed proved.
